11

Empty deleted items, and the 30-day rule

live now

SHIPPED — check this one

Where to look: Settings → Empty deleted items.

"Just make a notation under it that it's going to get deleted after 30 days."

was

Your planner held 72 deleted items, the oldest from 6 Aug, and nothing ever cleared them. The only way out was Delete forever on each — 144 presses.

now

One line empties them, and anything deleted over 30 days ago goes by itself. On your data that cleared 54 of the 72 the first time the planner opened.

What is safe about it: an item whose deletion date is missing or unreadable is never removed by the 30-day rule. Proven on purpose with six seeded entries (100 days, 31, 29, today, no date, broken date) — it removed exactly the first two.
